field.name: paymentInstrumentEnumId
field.description: The payment instrument used for the payment; for non-cash and other instruments represented by an account specify details of it with paymentMethodId

field.name: paymentMethodId
field.description: The from PaymentMethod (owned by fromPartyId)

field.name: toPaymentMethodId
field.description: The to PaymentMethod (owned by toPartyId), if applicable, the account the payment goes to

field.name: paymentGatewayConfigId
field.description: Use this PaymentGatewayConfig for auth/etc. For Payments by CC/etc that are not from an order and/or the order is not associated with a ProductStore. Also set automatically on auth for capture, etc.

field.name: orderId
field.description: Set if the Payment represents the payment settings for an Order.

field.name: orderPartSeqId
field.description: Set if the Payment represents the payment settings for an OrderPart.

field.name: orderItemSeqId
field.description: Set if the Payment represents the payment settings for an OrderItem.

field.name: effectiveDate
field.description: When the payment is issued (delivered)

field.name: settlementDate
field.description: When the payment is settled (confirmed)

field.name: dueDate
field.description: Due Date for this Payment, different concept than Invoice Due Date for planned split payments, etc

field.name: overrideGlAccountId
field.description: Overrides the GlAccount for the PaymentMethod entry, ie for the cash account the payment goes into.

field.name: overrideOrgPartyId
field.description: Used to specify the organization override rather than using the fromPartyId and/or toPartyId (depending on which is an internal org).

field.name: partyRelationshipId
field.description: For Payroll payments, points to Employment record

field.name: timePeriodId
field.description: For Payroll payments, points to Payroll TimePeriod

field.name: visitId
field.description: Track the Visit so we know the session info, including client IP, for audit and fraud purposes.

field.name: paymentMethodFileId
field.description: If included in a file for processing, file ID goes here

moqui.basic.Enumeration.description: Order for Direct Payment from Bank Account
Order for Direct Payment from Post Office Account

entity.description:
Evidence of payment fraud with references to the Payment and possibly OrderHeader that represents the fraud.
Other entities like ContactMech and PaymentMethod have a reference to this entity when they are gray- or black-listed based on this evidence.

Payment application to settle payments and invoices. Can be used for multiple scenarios using different fields:
1. Apply a Payment (paymentId) to an Invoice (invoiceId) 2. Apply a Payment (paymentId) such as a refund to another Payment (toPaymentId) such as an invoice payment 3. Apply an Invoice (invoiceId) such as a Credit Memo payable to another Invoice (toInvoiceId) such as a Sales/Purchase receivable
In all cases the two opposing records should have reverse from/to party IDs.
To constrain to these three scenarios if toPaymentId is set paymentId should always be set, and if toInvoiceId is set invoiceId should always be set.

field.name: overrideGlAccountId
field.description: If specified payment is applied directly against this GL account instead of the mapped AR/AP account

field.name: toPaymentId
field.description: Use to apply a Payment to another Payment like a payment that is a return of a mistaken or over-payment

field.name: toInvoiceId
field.description: Use to apply an Invoice to another Invoice like a Credit Memo payable to a Sales/Purchase receivable

entity.description: A batch of supplier payments from one of the organization's bank accounts: the due approved bills selected (PaymentRunItem), approved as a whole (its approved total and the version of its selection), then executed, one payment per supplier, with the bank file of its payments. A change to a supplier's bank details voids a pending approval (void#RunApproval).

field.name: paymentMethodId
field.description: The organization's bank account the run pays from.

field.name: paymentInstrumentEnumId
field.description: ACH (PiAch) or check (PiCompanyCheck).

field.name: approvedVersion
field.description: The fingerprint of the selection approved; execution refuses a selection that differs.

field.name: changedByUserIds
field.description: Each user who changed the run's selection, comma separated: none of them approves it unless the organization allows self-approval (SEC-BOS-126)

field.name: executeOperationKey
field.description: The claim of an execution in progress or done: the one key that may execute or resume the run; a completed execution is also a PostingOperation under the key.

field.name: executionMessage
field.description: Why an executed run is not finished yet (its bank file, or payments not yet applied); the same key resumes it.

field.name: paymentMethodFileId
field.description: The bank file of the run's payments: NACHA for ACH, Positive Pay for checks when the bank account has a format.

entity.description: A bill of a payment run: what was open and due when it was selected, the discount within its date, the amount to pay and whether it is in the run, or why it is left out (a hold, no bank account, the user). At execution each supplier's selected items get one payment (paymentId), and the result of each.

field.name: toPaymentMethodId
field.description: The supplier's bank account when it was selected.

field.name: discountInvoiceId
field.description: The prompt-payment discount credit applied to the bill.

moqui.basic.Enumeration.description: Paid by check or the payee's own channel

entity.description: A payment started from a Billing page (start#InvoicePayment): its invoice, the site and the link or contact it came from, and the digest of the reference the gateway's return carries. The pages show, refresh and capture only these payments, never one made in Accounting for the same invoice. Since Shop P5 it is Accounting's typed payment attempt (purposeEnumId): Shop's checkout attempts carry their order, checkout, store and site, the snapshot hash, phase, safe outcome and lookup backoff, and have no invoice.

field.name: settledDate
field.description: When the payment stopped being pending; the return reference reads the attempt for a day after it.

field.name: purposeEnumId
field.description: PaymentAttemptPurpose: PapInvoice (Billing, also when empty), PapShopCheckout, PapShopRenewal, PapEventRegistration.

field.name: snapshotHash
field.description: The hash of what the attempt charges (the caller's frozen snapshot).

field.name: phase
field.description: Where the attempt is: authorizing, pending (at the provider), authorized, placed, failed.

field.name: outcome
field.description: The safe outcome a customer may see: approved, declined, unknown, cancelled, mismatch.

field.name: nextCheckDate
field.description: When its worker looks it up next (bounded backoff).

entity.description: A deposit slip: receipts of one bank account and currency taken to the bank together, so the bank reports one line for them. Each receipt points at its deposit (Payment.paymentDepositId), and the deposit's one bank line reconciles them all (PaymentMethodTrans.paymentDepositId).

field.name: paymentMethodId
field.description: The bank account the receipts are deposited in

entity.description: A review its user confirms once: a settlement, automatic application, payment state change, unapplication, gateway action, refund or internal transfer (previewKindEnumId), or a settlement draft. The request is what confirming plans again, the payload what the user reviewed, and the result what confirming returned; a retry with the same operation key answers the result.

field.name: paymentId
field.description: The payment reviewed, or the source of an automatic application.

entity.description: What a payment's History shows beside its status audit log: each draft, edit, reviewed state change, unapplication and validation decision, by whom, with its reference and reason. A draft's event keeps the revision and method versions its validation notice approves.
